_about: royer-merge change-scoped checks for agency-landing-page-fm (affected-checks.mjs reads this before the toolbox's affected-checks.json). Added Oct 28, 2026 in the bottleneck rollout.

renders._about: A one-page site: every file under app/ or public/ renders /.

checks.name: own-specs
checks.what: the PR's own added or changed Playwright specs (they build and start the site on 127.0.0.1)
checks._boat: Off boat: playwright.config.ts asks for channel "chrome" (Google Chrome), which the box image doesn't ship; the specs also start `npm run start` on a fixed port. Runs on a Mac lane when a PR changes a spec.

checks.name: ui-quality-gate
checks.what: the UI quality gate on the pages the diff reaches, at promotion QA; merges skip it (main ships at merge, no promotion gate)

checks.name: qa
checks.what: independent royer-qa on the PR's own routes

checks.name: qa-gate
checks.what: QA at the head before merge (the carve-out: auth, payments, data, secrets and deploy config)

agency-landing-page-fm.setup: [ -d node_modules ] || if [ -f bun.lock ]; then b="${BUN:-$HOME/.bun/bin/bun}"; [ -x "$b" ] || b=$(command -v bun) || { echo 'setup: bun.lock but no bun (set BUN or install ~/.bun/bin/bun)' >&2; exit 1; }; NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG=/dev/null "$b" install --frozen-lockfile > /dev/null; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund > /dev/null 2>&1; fi
agency-landing-page-fm._setup: Bun is the package manager (Royer, Oct 27, 2026; answerbar #321). Same string as answerbar: bun install --frozen-lockfile with ~/.npmrc ignored, npm install on a branch without bun.lock.

boat._setup: Installs the packageManager's Bun (the box image's Bun 1.3.14 can't read bun.lock), then setup.
